key_insight: Diffusion Tree Sampling steers crystal generative models at inference time toward desired properties and Pareto trade-offs without retraining.
engineering_relevance: Engineers can reuse pretrained crystal generators to explore candidates with improved stability or targeted mechanical, electronic, and dielectric properties.
method: Use Monte Carlo tree search over diffusion denoising trajectories.
Integrate property-conditional models as guided proposals without distorting the target distribution.
Extend sampling to cover a Pareto front of competing objectives in one search.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved crystal stability, generation targeting rare space groups or high bulk modulus, and Pareto-front sampling for high dielectric constant and high bandgap, but provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Practical utility depends on property-evaluation accuracy and tree-search cost, neither quantified in the abstract.
paper_title: Diffusion Tree Sampling for Inference Time Adaptation of Crystal Generative Models
